items.subject: Application | Special Education Teacher, TSPS | Amer AlSaaideh
items.htmlBody:
Dear Springfield Primary School (TSPS) Hiring Team,

I am Amer Abdeljalil, a special education teacher and inclusive education coordinator with over five years in Jordanian Ministry of Education schools. I hold an MA in Special Education (Excellent) and I have worked in Qatar as a special education specialist. The school teaches Hindi, Malayalam, Arabic and Tamil alongside its core primary subjects.

  • Achieved full inclusion of students with disabilities for the first time in a public school.
  • Managed an individual education plan (IEP) for each student, built on formal and informal assessments.

I am applying for a Learning Support / Special Education Teacher or Shadow Teacher role. Please find my CV attached.

Kind regards,

Amer Abdeljalil AlSaaideh
Special Education Specialist | Inclusive Education Coordinator
MA in Special Education (Excellent) | 5+ years in Jordan and Qatar
Phone / WhatsApp+962 78 018 9766
Emailamer.abdeljalil77@gmail.com
LinkedInView my LinkedIn profile
Available immediately | Open to relocation
